ontology.note: PROV computation, WGS84 UTM calculation CRS, and GeoSPARQL CRS84 center geometry. A weighted run also asserts fw:weightField and fw:weightTotal, declared in ontology/fieldwork.ttl and emitted from src/mean-center.ts; the definition site named above asserts nothing itself.

changes.description: The Preview draws the points and the centre over them, and follows the weight being chosen: it had shown the saved one. The points are read with their values, so a weight is not refused there while the run takes it. The hint under the weight says what a weight does, not what it does to Snow's data.
